title: Experts disagree on new .github/workflows/plugin-eval.yml triggers
context:
Chief architect: both claims agree on dispatch plus weekly schedule; the security wording is stricter (it also rules out pull_request_target and other fork-reachable events) and names the reason, so it subsumes the cost-only wording

Target: new .github/workflows/plugin-eval.yml triggers
- devops-engineer: the workflow triggers only on workflow_dispatch and one weekly schedule, never on push or pull_request, so model cost stays bounded
- security-auditor: The workflow runs only on workflow_dispatch and schedule; it never runs on pull_request, pull_request_target or any fork-reachable event, because it runs the checked-out plugin with --trust-plugin and an outside-sandbox scaffold script while holding the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret.
